source_summary: Panoramic Chinese landscape with layered mountains, wooded shores, waterside villages, small pavilions, bridges, boats, and broad blank lake/mist areas. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: left_monumental_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large craggy mountain mass at the far upper left, including its steep rounded ridges, dark contour strokes, pale mineral washes, clustered evergreen texture on the slopes, and the tiny red-accent building tucked near the upper ridge. Exclude the lower village roofs and lakeshore structures.
must_preserve: bold layered contour linework on the mountain folds
dry-brush wrinkle texture and ink wash gradients
dark tree-dot clusters along the ridges
small red architectural accent near the upper slope
soft misty transition at the lower edge

motifs.name: left_shore_village_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the waterside village and arched bridge on the left shore below the mountain: low tiled-roof houses, a pale bridge crossing a narrow inlet, clustered trees, rocky banks, and horizontal water lines around the settlement.
must_preserve: angular grey roof geometry
fine house wall linework
arched bridge profile and supports
tree trunks and dotted foliage around the buildings
rocky shoreline strokes and thin water ripples

motifs.name: central_rocky_grove_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the central wooded rocky promontory with gnarled rocks, dense blue-green treetops, exposed pale trunks, and small pavilion or bridge elements at the water’s edge. Keep the compact island-like composition separate from surrounding lake mist.
must_preserve: twisted rock contour lines
dense stippled blue-green foliage
bare branching tree linework
small pavilion or bridge geometry at the base
soft shoreline wash where rock meets water

motifs.name: midleft_willow_shore_figure
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left low shoreline with rounded willow-like trees, sandy bank, scattered rocks, a small red-robed figure or rider on the path, and nearby low huts partly hidden by foliage.
must_preserve: rounded willow foliage washes
fine drooping branch lines
small red figure accent on the path
low hut roof lines behind trees
broken rock strokes and thin horizontal water marks

motifs.name: top_center_distant_hills_villages
motifs.description: Isolate the pale distant background band across the upper center: low layered hills, faint village roofs, small tree clusters, and misty water channels. Keep it as an atmospheric distance motif without foreground masses.
must_preserve: faint layered hill silhouettes
delicate roof and wall marks of distant hamlets
light blue-grey tree dots
soft mist edges between land and water
subtle horizontal water and shoreline strokes

motifs.name: central_tiny_boat_on_lake
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat in the open lake near the center, including the seated figures or cargo hints, slim hull, oar-like lines, and sparse ripples around it. Include only enough blank water to preserve its scale and placement.
must_preserve: thin dark hull line
tiny red-brown figure or cargo accents
delicate oar or pole marks
minimal horizontal ripples
surrounding pale water wash for breathing space

motifs.name: right_cliffside_village_harbor
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side rocky shoreline village beneath the cliffs: clustered tiled roofs, pavilions, retaining walls, trees with reddish branches, boulders, and the small harbor edge projecting into the lake. Exclude the large mountain above except where it directly forms the village backdrop.
must_preserve: precise dark roof ridgelines and eaves
pale wall planes and stepped building placement
reddish-brown tree branches among blue-green foliage
rounded boulder texture along the shore
thin waterline strokes at the harbor edge

motifs.name: right_mountain_waterfall_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the great mountain mass on the right with its sweeping vertical folds, pale waterfall or misty cleft, wooded lower slopes, and small buildings nestled below the cliff. Do not include the red seals or calligraphy on the far right margin.
must_preserve: broad arcing mountain contour strokes
dry-brush texture on rounded ridges
pale waterfall or mist streak descending the cliff
dark clustered foliage at the mountain base
small roof forms nestled under the rock face

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
